primary_reference: Two user-provided photographs, the second showing the complete five-gauge panel.
visible_structure: Compact sloped-shoulder grey plate; five equal 144px gauges with 12px horizontal gaps. Four X-diagonal mounts per dial. Upper two title plaques omitted, lower three nameplates retained.

supporting_primary_sources.title: 1968 T-54/T-54A military repair manual
supporting_primary_sources.use: Related-family instrument terminology only. User explicitly identifies the photographed lower-right instrument as fuel quantity; this correction takes precedence over the earlier oil-pressure inference.

adaptation.upper_two_gauges: Speed and engine RPM functions/readouts retained; only their title plaques are removed at the user request. Original gauge identity/lettering is not legible in the photo.
adaptation.lower_three: Separate pose dial, player-view-up rotating compass and fuel quantity, all 144px diameter. These are requested game HUD adaptations, not original factory functions.
adaptation.pose: Cannon fixed up; hull rotates relative to the turret from the actual shared joint angle independently of player camera heading. Original T90A cannon-up reference and minimal graphics restored. No tracks, hatches or hull-reference caption. Detached/missing connector: hide symbols and show --. Full-circle yaw is reconstructed from connector Euler X/Y to avoid quadrant folding.
adaptation.compass: Player/camera view is fixed upward; compass rose and N/E/S/W rotate by negative hud.view_heading_deg. Fixed central arrow is the viewing direction, not cannon or hull north.
adaptation.fuel_scale: User deferred scale correction: keep normalized 0 / 1/2 / 1 (empty / half / full), and mark the near-empty 0–0.2 sector red. This is a static face marking, not a live fuel warning; no confirmed fuel signal means -- and no needle. No unverified litre capacity.
adaptation.bearing_and_gear: Supplementary strip shows exact camera bearing and gear.
adaptation.outline_and_mounts: User orange shoulder contour and 45/135/225/315 degree X mounts; horizontal dial gaps tightened to 12px.
adaptation.dial_ranges: HUD calibration: speed 0–80 km/h, RPM 0–3000; face layouts are redraws, not exact factory scans.

artwork: New code-authored SVG and matching 4x PNGs. No reference photo pixels, browser chrome, captions or watermarks are shipped.
rendering: Current AUI caches a transform when only the CSS custom property changes. Balanced string class selection and literal 1-degree transforms make hull, compass and both live needles invalidate the native render cache. Numeric readouts retain actual values.
game_validation: User explicitly takes responsibility for in-game validation of this revision.
